page.notes: Hebrew and Greek are copied as far as legible. The Hebrew "ולוהוה" and the Greek after "εἰς τ-" are doubtful and marked [?]. The Greek fragment "λ" is only partly legible. The connector marks after "inimicorum", "Surge" and "Seculum" are printed separators, not letters. "præsentissimo" and "mundum" follow the printed forms as closely as the scan allows. The top-right catchword "hova" is set right below the last line of text.
